candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service (pool size 5, idle 0) causes save_order to fail with DependencyUnavailable, producing 503 on /v1/orders and 502 on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show pool size 5 with 0 idle and ~2s save_order failures; no direct postgres server-side metrics to confirm saturation vs. slow queries.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with order-service save_order failures: postgres spans report DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and idle 0, and /v1/orders returns 503, propagating as 502 at the gateway. Bounded candidate is db-pool-exhaustion; server-side pool metrics would confirm saturation.
missing_evidence: Postgres server metrics (active/idle connections, wait time, max_connections) for the order service
Order service logs showing pool acquisition timeouts or connection errors
